spec.claim_summary: Buying Bitcoin when its price falls below its 200-week moving average.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Asset interpreted as BTCUSDT spot; claim says Bitcoin.
Timeframe set to 1d; claim states no bar timeframe.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: true 200-week moving average on weekly closes; approximated as 1400-day SMA (200*7) on 1d bars because only 1h/4h/1d are available.
Entry interpreted as crosses_below trigger from falls below and automatic trigger rather than holding below.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim gives no exit and implies buy-and-hold to present; schema requires a time exit so a distant max_hold_bars is used to approximate holding to end of history.

evidence.quote: When Bitcoin's price falls below its 200-week moving average
